name: Westin Galleria Houston
positioning: The Westin Galleria Houston: an Uptown Houston hotel inside The Galleria, Texas' largest shopping center, with skyline views from its Concierge Lounge and fitness studio
best_for: Shoppers who want The Galleria without leaving the building
Families and business travelers who want space in one- or two-bedroom suites

facts.text: The hotel is in Uptown Houston.
The Galleria is Texas' largest shopping center.
The Galleria has 400 stores and restaurants across more than 2.4 million square feet.
Suites can be configured with one or two bedrooms.
The fitness studio has Peloton bikes, free weights and cross trainers.
Guests can request WestinWORKOUT gear lending kits with Hyperice and Bala recovery and strength gear.
The hotel has an outdoor pool.
The Daily Grill serves classic American dishes made from scratch for breakfast, lunch and dinner.

highlights.text: Guests can shop at The Galleria without leaving the building.
The Concierge Lounge is on the 24th floor, with panoramic views of the Houston skyline and a full hot breakfast.
Rooms have the Westin Heavenly Bed, the Heavenly Bath, White Tea amenities and deluxe robes.
The WestinWORKOUT Fitness Studio has panoramic views.

considerations.text: The hotel is in Uptown Houston and shares its building with The Galleria mall.
WhataHotel notes the busy shopping center environment may lack tranquility.
